components.title: Agent Skill Library
components.purpose: Delivers reusable agent capabilities as self-contained skill directories, each carrying a SKILL.md manifest with YAML frontmatter plus optional reference documents, executable scripts, and templates that the agent loads on demand.

primary.rationale: Every top-level skill definition and its bundled references live here; this directory is the component.

shared.rationale: Authoring scaffolds for new skills, also used when a command needs to emit a skill-shaped artifact.

components.title: Slash Command Surface
components.purpose: Delivers namespaced slash commands as flat markdown files under commands/<namespace>/, where the team namespace carries the four-layer orchestration router that selects roles and sequences agent handoffs. The core tree ships 38; a further 242 Super Intelligence commands are generated at install time from the team registries rather than committed, so the installed surface is roughly eight times the size of this directory.

primary.rationale: All command definitions plus the /team router, its role registry, and its protocol files live here.

components.title: Bundled Orchestration Systems
components.purpose: Delivers multi-phase project orchestration, knowledge tracking, media production, and persona-council capabilities as optional bundles, each shipping its own nested skills and agents that install independently of the core asset set. The Super Intelligence bundle carries the registries and generators that produce the 242-command family.

primary.rationale: The GSD, brain, superintelligence, and team bundles, each self-contained with its own nested skills directory.

components.title: Subagent Role Definitions
components.purpose: Delivers the named subagent roles that commands dispatch work to, together with the behavioural rules those agents load, so that a role's system prompt is defined once and reused across every pipeline that spawns it.

primary.rationale: Agent role definitions and the behavioural rule set they carry; both are dispatched by the command surface rather than invoked directly.

components.title: Multi-Editor Install Adapters
components.purpose: Delivers installation into five editor and CLI targets — Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and the Copilot CLI, Codex, and any AGENTS.md consumer — by linking skills, commands and agents into each tool's configuration directory under a per-target namespace mapping, with an npm wrapper and a Homebrew formula for bootstrap.

primary.rationale: One directory per target, each holding an install.sh, a manifest.json declaring the surfaces and bundles it supports, and a README. The manifests are the machine-readable contract; scripts/build-delivery-index.py installs every adapter into a throwaway HOME and records what it actually delivered in adapters/INDEX.md.

notes: Structural index only. Component altitude is C4-Container; these paths are not work-assignment boundaries. Build tooling (scripts/), generated catalogs (docs/), CI workflows, tests, examples, and static assets are deliberately excluded under the runtime-only rule in references/component-rules.md, so they appear in no component. What each component actually installs is recorded separately, and empirically, in adapters/INDEX.md.
